svg.text: ABAN — 30 ml EXTRAIT FLACON, SECTIONS THROUGH THE AXIS

Original Rhino model at real scale (×2.505); glass made solid from the original outer and inner skins; ground neck and stopper. Outer surface kept below the neck land (max deviation 0.0042 mm, at the stitched seam).
Source outer surface below the land
All 8 checks pass: wall min, neck radial min 1.6, capacity window, stopper clear, holder clearance, bottle supported, no unexpected interference, exterior within 0.005 below land

Glass (light blue), juice to the 30 ml line (amber), stopper head + shank (gold hatch), display holder, seat pad and stand (velvet). Stopper: zamak, gold plated; shank PTFE-sleeved in a 1:10 ground bore.
